boxes.title: More Tirthankara facts
head: Tirthankara
Added detail
rows: Born Varanasi; **Asvasena + Vama**; renounced at 30, enlightened after **84 days**, died at **100**; ~**250 years** before Mahavira; eternity of matter; followers in white

boxes.title: Historicity & Mahavira: added
items: Only last two historical (Jain + Buddhist sources); first **22** uncertain
Birth also **Basukunda**; ⚠ other notes: **540 BC** birth, **c. 468 BC** death
Titles: **Nirgrantha**, **Kevalin**, **Arhat**; ==**Lichchhavi republic** first to recognise Jainism==
Contemporaries: **Prasenjit** (Kosala), **Pradyota** (Avanti); teachers **Purana Kassapa, Ajita Kesakambalin, Pakudha Kachchayana, Sanjaya Belatthiputta**
⚠ Gosala called Mahavira's "guru" in some notes; Jain texts: his disciple

boxes.title: Practices
head: Practice
Meaning
rows: Non-injury, non-stealing, non-adultery, truth, non-possession + daily food charity
= Sallekhana: ==gradual cut of food, liquid==; last vow

boxes.title: Andhra & significance
items: Kakatiya Jain phase: ==**Siddeshwara Charitra**==; **Prolaraju**'s Hanamkonda inscription opens with Jain prayer
Decline: severe austerities, lost patronage, sect split
